summary: Prepared source extends the existing maintained routine-delivery route: ordinary FS-GG/.github invocations select the native run from the unique receiver-required coherence/projection job reference, verify native job/run/attempt/candidate and the existing checkout artifact, then recheck the required reference and run identity. Missing, stale, ambiguous, rerun or drifting evidence remains unavailable. Historical explicit-run selection keeps the exact retired producer pair and strict postmerge empty-link fallback. The result preserves the original outcome, coherent/routine states, effect count and native merge identity; its ready/delivered/attention assessment is evidence projection without effect authority. Compact output reserves space within the existing64KiB recovery custody bound; omitted check/file populations are explicit and cannot count as complete. Installation/recovery retain legacy output, source blob cap and original effect restrictions. The maintained public reader accepts only the bounded versioned nested shape, while the observer marks its assessment reported rather than authenticating supplied JSON or granting economic qualification. No new CI job, metadata ledger, comparison gate or log ingestion is added. Protected PR4604 deployed the existing unfiltered projection checkout producer. The genuine roadmap-only PR4607 had no skill-quality run; coherence run38866764067/artifact12030918081 bound synthetic checkout7dbb1112/tree2a7bc98a to native protected merge638b4b26 with identical tree, all8required checks passing and no collection exception. A read-only call from the cited prepared automatic source selected that same run/artifact without a run argument, with zero effect attempts and no issues. These observations establish that producer witness and prepared-reader behavior, not hosted deployment of the automatic changes, every-job coverage, fleet adoption or measured savings.
title: The maintained delivery route automatically assembles bounded checkout evidence
